prompt:
[Composition/Camera Angle]
Mid-shot, waist-up to medium shot captured at eye level with a slight diagonal. A cinematic horizontal composition (3:4) conveying the openness of a Parisian cafe terrace. Background cityscape and the cafe's red awning are appropriately blurred (depth of field around F1.8 to F2.8), guiding the viewer's gaze to the subject's delicate expression and hand details.

[Subject/Pose/Gesture/Fashion Description]
A woman sitting at a terrace table of a Saint-Germain cafe. Wearing a loose, oversized white linen shirt (several top buttons open to show a natural V-line from neck to décolletage) and tight black skinny pants. Classic black cat-eye sunglasses are casually placed on top of her head. Holding a ceramic coffee cup with beautiful latte art in one hand, she gazes at passersby with a sophisticated, ennui expression. Natural wrinkles in the linen shirt, 3D folds in the fabric swaying gently in the wind, relaxed yet refined posture.

[Exact Application of Features and Structure from Reference Image (Image Reference)]
Face/Expression: Accurately reference and reproduce the facial structure, placement of parts (eye shape, bridge of nose, mouth), skin texture, and nuances of the ennui eyes from the [reference image].
Hairstyle/Hair Color: Completely reproduce the hair length, volume, flow of tips, and hair color from the [reference image].
Body Type/Structure: Apply the neck-to-shoulder line, thickness of the chest, torso silhouette, and length of hands and fingers from the [reference image] as a base.

[Space/Lighting/Atmosphere]
The historic streets of Saint-Germain-des-Prés in Paris and the vivid red cafe awning. Soft afternoon sunlight shines through the roadside trees, casting beautiful dappled light and shadows (Chiaroscuro effect) on the table, her skin, and the linen shirt. The overall tone is a warm natural palette, with lighting that evokes the relaxed, sophisticated flow of time characteristic of Parisian cafes.

promptZh:
[构图/摄像机角度]
中景，从腰部以上到中景，以平视视角拍摄，略带对角线构图。电影感的横向构图（3:4），传达出巴黎咖啡馆露台的开阔感。背景城市景观和咖啡馆的红色遮阳篷经过适当虚化（景深约为 F1.8 到 F2.8），引导观众的视线聚焦于主体细腻的表情和手部细节。

[主体/姿势/手势/服装描述]
一位坐在 圣日耳曼咖啡馆 露台桌旁的女性。身穿 一件宽松的白色亚麻衬衫（解开几颗上扣，露出颈部到锁骨的自然 V 领）和紧身黑色长裤。经典的黑色猫眼太阳镜随意地架在头顶。一只手拿着绘有精美拉花的陶瓷咖啡杯，以 精致而慵懒的神情 注视着路人。亚麻衬衫上的自然褶皱，织物随风轻轻摆动的 3D 折痕，姿态放松而优雅。

[参考图像中特征与结构的精确应用（图像参考）]
脸部/表情：准确参考并还原 [参考图像] 中的面部结构、五官位置（眼型、鼻梁、嘴部）、皮肤质感以及慵懒眼神的神韵。
发型/发色：完全还原 [参考图像] 中的头发长度、发量、发梢走向及发色。
体型/结构：以 [参考图像] 中的颈肩线条、胸部厚度、躯干轮廓以及手部和手指长度为基础进行应用。

[空间/光影/氛围]
巴黎圣日耳曼德佩区（Saint-Germain-des-Prés）的历史街道和鲜艳的红色咖啡馆遮阳篷。柔和的午后阳光透过路边的树木，在桌面、她的皮肤和亚麻衬衫上投下斑驳美丽的光影（明暗对照法）。整体色调为温暖的自然色系，光线营造出巴黎咖啡馆特有的那种放松且精致的时间流逝感。
